approved_decisions.3H-1: Keep the A1 prospect as the main Twenty record and use a linked versioned A2 review record.
approved_decisions.3H-2: Use pending, in_review, needs_changes, held, approved and rejected review states.
approved_decisions.3H-3: Support field-level decisions, corrected values, comments and a record-level decision.
approved_decisions.3H-4: Require reviewer identity, role, timestamp, reason and an idempotent receipt.
approved_decisions.3H-5: Let Twenty approval authorize proposed HubSpot patch preparation only.
approved_decisions.3H-6: Require corrected values to create a new canonical A2 revision.
approved_decisions.3H-7: Keep canonical JSON as the lossless source and Twenty as a review projection/input layer.
approved_decisions.3H-8: Use role-scoped Twenty API access and n8n filtering/deduplication after integration approval.
approved_decisions.3H-9: Reject duplicate or mismatched Twenty candidate/review events.
approved_decisions.3H-10: Keep HubSpot write and outreach authorization false in every Twenty review receipt.

remaining_integration_inputs: Twenty workspace URL and deployment type
exact A1 prospect object and internal name
workspace metadata export for objects, fields and relations
reviewer and backup plus Twenty roles
API key owner and role scopes
field-decision child object versus structured-field decision
